messages:
Eli: quick sync — Customer Delta wants a 6-month enterprise commit. main ask: stable 5k rps on chat (avg payload ~350 tokens) during business hours, spike to 8k rps for 15–30m windows. need guidance on reserved GPU counts, autoscale headroom, and pricing tiers.
Priya: are those rps numbers for single-region? they said EU + NA, but traffic split 70/30 NA.
Eli: yes split ~70% NA. 5k rps is global baseline. they expect failover to NA if EU capacity constrained.
Samir: baseline sizing: with our runtime bench (redwood/v2-like on A10Gish), for chat with kv-cache warm and batching, rough tokens/s per GPU: ~120k tokens/s (varies by seq len + model). for 350-token avg -> ~343 convs/s per GPU. that maps to ~29k rps-token-equivalent? rough calc below.
Jordan: can you paste the calc? pricing will hinge on committed GPUs vs burst credits.
Samir: quick calc: avg request = 350 tokens => tokens/s at 5k rps = 1.75M tokens/s. at 120k tokens/s per GPU -> 1.75M / 120k = ~14.6 GPUs. add 20% headroom for spikes + autoscale latency targets => round to 18 reserved GPUs NA+EU combined. if we split by traffic (70/30) => NA 13, EU 5.
Priya: makes sense. for the POC we usually recommend a smaller reserve + burst credits. propose commit for 12 reserved GPUs (NA 9, EU 3) + burst pool of 6 GPUs for spikes. that keeps initial cost lower and shows throughput.
Jordan: signing numbers: 12 reserved gives discount tier X. ask: does finance allow scaling the commit mid-term? customer likely to want runway.
Lina: yes we support commit amendments quarterly, but discount tiers are based on committed baseline. bursts billed separately; we can include explicit burst-credit pricing in the SOW.
Eli: can we provide an autoscale policy example they can review? need p99 targets: p50<200ms, p95<350ms, p99<900ms.
Samir: sample autoscale YAML (for their SRE review):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 8
  target_token_utilization: 0.75
  scale_up_threshold_seconds: 15
  scale_down_threshold_seconds: 120
  max_replicas: 30
  prewarm_replicas: 4  # keep small pool for cold-starts
  fallback_model: "redwood-quantized-2.7b"
```
Samir: notes — prewarm helps reduce cold KV-cache penalties for chat. fallback_model reduces cost and keeps tail latency predictable if primary model runs out of capacity.
Priya: security Q: they asked about KMS rotation and data residency for EU. can we confirm private deployment options?
Lina: Private (VPC) supports customer KMS and on-prem packaging. for EU residency we can deploy control plane in EU region and restrict logs retention. add that to the security questionnaire.
Jordan: pricing followup — customer asked if we can cap monthly spend for bursts. we can offer a capped burst budget with alerts + auto-throttle to protect billing. include in SOW.
Eli: for the POC timeline: want 2-week POC with traffic replay and a soak day at 5k rps. propose day1: baseline perf runs, day7: scale tests to 8k spike windows, day12: security questionnaire handoff, day14: sign/convert. ok?
Priya: sounds good. I'll own the SOW draft and coordinate legal redlines.
Samir: action on infra: I'll provision dedicated pool (NA 9, EU 3) as staging for POC and attach burst pool. expect ready in ~36h.
deploy-bot: new-dedicated-pool created: pool-id dp-9a2f, region: us-west-2, replicas: 9 (provisioning).
Lina: I'll prepare the security answers for KMS, audit logs, and network diagrams.
Jordan: I'll prepare pricing grid: commit levels (12, 18, 24 GPUs) with per-GPU/month, burst-credit rates, and estimated monthly token bill for 5k rps baseline. will post by EOD.
Eli: thanks — final ask before SOW: can engineering confirm model variants for fallback (half-precision vs 8-bit quant) and expected quality delta? we need a line in SOW about quality SLAs.
Samir: we recommend primary = open-chat-13b-fp16, fallback = open-chat-7b-8bit. expected median quality delta <5% on our evals for QPS-heavy workloads. will attach eval summary to POC docs.
Eli: perfect. action items: Priya drafts SOW, Jordan pricing grid, Samir infra + evals, Lina security questionnaire. meet Wed 10am to finalize. :thumbsup:
Priya: noted. I'll ping legal for SOW template.
Samir: infra ticket -> INF-4721, will update when pool is active.
Eli: closing thread — thanks team.
